SELECT ti.id, ti.title, ti.scope, ti.content_type, ti.category_id, ic.name AS category_name, ( SELECT ii.image_url FROM info_images ii WHERE ii.info_id = ti.id AND ( (ti.content_type = 'FESTIVAL' AND (ii.is_thumbnail = 1 OR ii.is_main = 1)) OR (ti.content_type != 'FESTIVAL' AND ii.is_main = 1) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ti.content_type = 'FESTIVAL' AND ii.is_thumbnail = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, ii.order_index ASC, ii.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnail_url, ti.views, ti.created_at, representative_period.start_date, representative_period.end_date FROM travel_info ti JOIN info_categories ic ON ic.id = ti.category_id LEFT JOIN info_periods representative_period ON representative_period.id = ( SELECT period_candidate.id FROM info_periods period_candidate WHERE period_candidate.info_id = ti.id AND ti.content_type = 'FESTIVAL' ORDER BY CASE WHEN period_candidate.start_date <= CURDATE() AND period_candidate.end_date >= CURDATE() THEN 0 WHEN period_candidate.start_date > CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, CASE WHEN period_candidate.start_date > CURDATE() THEN period_candidate.start_date END ASC, CASE WHEN period_candidate.end_date < CURDATE() THEN period_candidate.end_date END DESC, period_candidate.start_date ASC, period_candidate.id ASC LIMIT 1 )
ORDER BY ti.views DESC, ti.created_at DESC, ti.id DESC
ORDER BY ti.created_at DESC, ti.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.update: UPDATE travel_info ti JOIN info_categories ic ON ic.id = ti.category_id AND ic.is_visible = 1 SET ti.views = ti.views + 1, ti.updated_at = ti.updated_at WHERE ti.id = #{id}
